primitives.name: Distinction
primitives.statement: There exist realizations x and y such that x is not equivalent to y.

primitives.name: Relation
primitives.statement: Admissible ordered or unordered relations may hold among realizations.

primitives.name: Transformation
primitives.statement: Some related realizations admit composable admissible mappings.

definitions.name: Reachability
definitions.statement: y is reachable from x if there exists a finite admissible composition of transformations from x to y.

definitions.name: EquivalenceUnderReachability
definitions.statement: x and y are equivalent when each is reachable from the other.

definitions.name: IrreversiblePair
definitions.statement: x precedes y when y is reachable from x and x is not reachable from y.

claims.statement: Irreversible reachability induces a strict partial order on equivalence classes under mutual reachability.
A time-like ordering may be representable as an order-preserving map from the irreversible reachability quotient into an ordered set.

observables.name: ReachabilityQuery
observables.definition: Whether an admissible path exists from x to y in a finite model.

falsifiers.condition: Construct a finite admissible model in which irreversible reachability on mutual-reachability equivalence classes fails transitivity or irreflexivity.

metadata.purpose: Minimal formal toy model for anti-smuggling and countermodel testing.
